summary: Iteration 17 backend testing: verified new depreciation row in /api/reports.income. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_depreciation.py with 11 tests covering: presence of income.depreciation & net_profit fields, net_profit formula (gross_profit - operating_expense - depreciation), non-Semua channel forces depreciation=0, monthly period 2026-08 with two deterministic assets (500k combined), previous-period block also adjusted, assets purchased AFTER period end contribute 0, expired assets (life_end < period start) contribute 0, quarterly Q3 2026 accumulates 3 months per asset (>=1.5M for A1+A2), depreciation is non-cash (cash.net = cash.in - cash.out), balance sheet A == L+E, and for granularity=all depreciation equals sum of total_akumulasi_penyusutan in balance detail. Also ran iter16 regression suite: 31/31 pass. All 11 iter17 tests PASS. Cleanup handled via fixture teardown deleting the 3 TEST_ prefixed assets.
critical_code_review_comments: _dep_in_range uses date(year, month, 1) for life_end and truncates day component of start/end via _period_range -> _date.fromisoformat(iso[:10]). This is consistent (whole-month buckets) and produces the expected straight-line months count. Good.

For channel != 'Semua', depreciation is intentionally 0 (mirrors opex logic). This is consistent but may be surprising if users expect a per-channel PnL to show non-cash charges. Consider documenting in UI tooltip.
server.py is 981 lines — approaching the 700-line soft threshold; consider splitting reports/assets/cash_movements into modules (non-blocking).

balance_sheet detail computes total_akumulasi_penyusutan independently from _asset_derived; iter17 all-time depreciation uses same helper — verified they match (test_all_time_depreciation_equals_accumulated_sum passes).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 temporary assets (TEST_iter17_A1, A2, A3_expired) via POST /api/assets and deleted them in fixture teardown. No polluting data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter17 depreciation feature fully verified. /api/reports.income now includes 'depreciation' and adjusted 'net_profit'. Non-cash: cash.in/out/net unaffected. For channel != Semua depreciation=0. For granularity=all, income.depreciation == balance.detail.assets.tetap.total_akumulasi_penyusutan. Existing seed asset (Mesin Jahit Juki 250k/mo starting 2025-06-01) remains in DB.
